//: Save as %USERPROFILE%\.r2\<bucket>.json on each PC that publishes — never in a repo, never in Dropbox. Garth pastes the values; a session never sees them. A value still in <angle brackets> counts as missing.
accountId: <account id — R2 overview page, right-hand column>
accessKeyId: <Access Key ID — shown once when the R2 API token is created>
secretAccessKey: <Secret Access Key — shown once, same screen>
//access: Only for a site behind Cloudflare Access (RUNBOOK §6): the service token the publish script shows the host. Leave the placeholders if there is none.
